changelog:
[B][COLOR ff00fa9a]Version 2.0.26[/COLOR][/B]
[COLOR fffdb515]New: smart search[/COLOR]
-Searching no longer waits for the slowest provider. Until now the source list opened only when every provider had answered or the scraper timeout ran out, so it took 3, 7, 12 or 20 seconds depending on what you had turned on. In tests on a tablet with ten providers it now opens in about 3 seconds.
-luc_kodi learns how long each provider takes and what it brings, for movies, episodes and season and show packs. Once enough sources are ready to play in the two best qualities you allow, the providers still searching get a short margin and the list opens: 2 seconds when there is just enough, half a second when there is plenty, and a little more for providers that often find sources nobody else has.
-Ready to play means what will really be in your list: cached on Premiumize, TorBox or Offcloud, already resolved by a Custom provider, in your cloud, NZBs found on Easynews, or the torrents Real-Debrid and AllDebrid show unchecked. With fewer ready than that nothing changes: it waits for everyone, as before.
-A provider still searching when the list opens keeps going in the background. Once it finishes, the next time you open the title the full list, with what it found, is ready at once.
-Settings > Source Options > Scraper Progress Dialog: Smart search (on by default) and how many sources should be ready: 10 for autoplay, twice that when the source list opens. Rescrape Item with All Providers still waits for every provider.
-Each search writes one line in the Kodi log with where the time went: when enough sources were ready, the margin used, the debrid check, the filtering, and when each provider answered and with how many results.
[COLOR fffdb515]Faster debrid check[/COLOR]
-Premiumize, TorBox and Offcloud are asked while the search runs, as results come in and in parts of 100, instead of all at once at the end. By the time the list opens the check is done.
-Each torrent's cache status is remembered on its own: 6 hours when cached, 1 hour when not. Before, an answer was kept for the whole set of results, and one different result meant asking again for all of them.
[COLOR fffdb515]New: Search speed[/COLOR]
-Tools > Search speed shows your setup (providers on, which debrid services check the cache, Usenet) and, for each provider, how long it usually takes, how many results it brings, how many are ready to play and how many only it finds.
-Providers that are slow and almost never bring anything the others do not are marked, and you can turn them off from there. Forget what smart search has learned is under the same settings.
[COLOR fffdb515]Fixes[/COLOR]
-Removing duplicate sources takes about half the time with long lists, with the same result.
